text:
julia: dropping notes from the API keys design review. main points: make revoke consequences clearer, avoid accidental rotate, improve show-secret a11y, and tighten empty-state copy. figma attached.

mike: quick Q 1A0 why is Rotate the primary CTA in the slide-over? ops folks expect Revoke to be more obvious.

julia: we intentionally made Rotate primary to nudge safer flows (regen > blind delete). but agree revoke must be obvious. proposal: Rotate = solid primary, Revoke = left-aligned red text-button with trash icon.

aisha: thumbs up. also add a short helper under the scope chips: "Rotation preserves scopes (Admin / Read / Embed-only)" 1 clients keep asking if scopes change.

dan: a11y points: 1) show-secret icon button has no informative aria-label; 2) switching input type doesn't announce to screenreaders. need aria-expanded, aria-controls, and an aria-live region announcing "API secret revealed" / "API secret hidden".

sam: mobile note: slide-over becomes full-screen on narrow view. ensure the rotate/revoke buttons are reachable above the soft keyboard and respect safe-area insets.

julia: copy for revoke modal 1 current: "Are you sure?" 1 too vague. suggested: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it. This action cannot be undone." Buttons: Cancel (primary), Revoke key (danger). add small link: "Run dependency scan" to help owners identify impacted services.

aisha: legal wants a line: "This action will be recorded in Audit logs." include it in the modal footer with a link to Audit.

dan: modal a11y checklist: focus trap, aria-describedby for the revoke button referencing the consequence text, Escape closes modal, and keyboard activation works.

mike: copy-to-clipboard: please use aria-label "Copy secret to clipboard" and a toast that says "Copied API key" with role="status" and aria-live="polite". do not shift focus to the toast.

julia: empty state wording debate: options were "Create your first key" vs "Add API key" vs "Generate key". analytics show new users search "create" more. i propose: Heading: "No API keys yet" CTA: "Create your first key" Subcopy: "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely."

aisha: agreed. also ensure the decorative illustration has empty alt="" and heading uses H2 on the dashboard.

dan: small contrast fix: hint text under key row is 12px grey 1 raise to 14px and token color-strong to meet AA. copy-to-clipboard tooltip should be visible on hover and accessible via keyboard.

sam: small UX improvement: when rotating we show the one-time secret. microcopy must be explicit: "This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store it in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value." Offer Copy and optional "Download .env" (client-only).

mike: backend will return secret once; client must avoid logging it. implement copy toast and optional download blob.

julia: action items: julia to update figma with revised modal and empty state copy; mike to implement aria-live & copy toast; dan to run quick a11y pass; sam to validate mobile placements and safe-area; aisha to finalize wording with legal. will paste final strings here once reviewed.

mike: quick dev note 1 use aria-controls and aria-expanded on the toggle button, and update the aria-live region text rather than relying on type attribute changes alone.

dan: agreed. also ensure the copy button sets aria-pressed briefly during the copy animation for assistive tech feedback.

julia: thanks team 31F will update figma and follow up.
